# Machine-readable summary for AI assistants and crawlers.

> AxisForge Labs builds fixed-scope custom AI tools and automations for companies.
> Price is agreed before engineering starts. Scope is frozen after kickoff.
> Clients keep code, accounts, and API keys after handoff.

## Ideal customer

- Ops, product, or eng-adjacent leaders at 10–150 person companies
- Bootstrapped B2B SaaS founders ($5K–$200K MRR) with backlog items stuck
- Trigger: backlog slipping, need clean quote, Q2/quarter-end shipping pressure
- Pain: open-ended agency retainers, mystery process, projects that never ship

## Packages (fixed price)

| Price | Label | Best for |
|-------|-------|----------|
| $1,000 | Focused build | One clear automation or small internal tool |
| $1,500 | Standard build | Real software with integrations (email, Slack, DB) — most chosen |
| $3,000 | Advanced build | Heavier integrations, approvals in the loop, sophisticated AI where earned |

Payment: 50% deposit at kickoff, 50% on delivery. Written scope and definition of done before build starts.

## Productized offers (fixed scope pages)

- Lead Qualifier ($1,500, 5 days): https://getyourproductbuilt.com/offers/lead-qualifier
  Webhook → enrichment → ICP scoring → AI-drafted email → Slack approval → CRM

- Inbox Triage ($1,500, 5 days): https://getyourproductbuilt.com/offers/inbox-triage
  Gmail classification → human-approved drafts → Slack escalation

- Weekly Report ($1,500, 4 days): https://getyourproductbuilt.com/offers/weekly-report
  Stripe + analytics + project tools → scheduled executive narrative → email/Slack

## Free tools

- Scope Estimator: https://getyourproductbuilt.com/tools/scope-estimator
  Recommends package tier based on problem type, integrations, and timeline.

## How we work

1. 15-minute intro call to qualify fit and scope band
2. Written scope + fixed price before engineering
3. Deposit at kickoff; scope frozen after sign-off
4. Structured progress updates during build
5. Recorded handoff walkthrough; client owns all assets

## Differentiation vs alternatives

- vs agency retainer: fixed price upfront, bounded scope, days not months
- vs DIY no-code (Zapier/Make/Clay): custom code you own, tuned to your ICP/rules
- vs hiring: faster than recruiting; no long-term headcount
